name: @ovarilo/csms-drivers
description: Reusable CSMS driver library: typed OCPP 1.6 and 2.0.1 operation contracts, charge-point administration, SteVe and CitrineOS drivers, and an HTTP/JSON handler over any driver.
author: Julien Herr

scripts.test: bun run build && bash scripts/boundary.sh && bun tests/csms-driver-factories.ts && bun tests/csms-driver-charge-points.ts && bun tests/csms-server.ts && bun tests/release-changelog.ts && bun tests/package-content.ts && bun tests/release-state.ts && bun examples/csms-driver-smoke.ts && bash scripts/package-smoke.sh
scripts.check: vp check && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun scripts/check-package.ts
